text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: EasyRPG is an open-source project that recreates the runtime environment for RPG Maker 2000 and RPG Maker 2003 games. Instead of emulating Windows, it runs compatible games natively on modern platforms while preserving their original graphics, music, and gameplay. EasyRPG supports thousands of fan-made RPGs and independent creations, making it one of the most popular ways to experience classic RPG Maker games on current hardware.
